assessment.title: English Placement Assessment
assessment.description: Evaluación de ubicación de 13 preguntas (A1–B2) que mide Grammar, Vocabulary, Reading, Listening y Speaking.

stimuli.title: A new job, a new language
stimuli.content: Laura is a nurse from Medellín. Last year, a hospital in Toronto offered her a remote job reviewing medical reports at night. The salary was excellent, but there was one problem: every report was written in English. At first, Laura needed almost two hours to read a single report. She started studying for thirty minutes every morning before breakfast, and she kept a notebook with new medical words. Six months later, she can read a report in twenty minutes, and her manager has asked her to train two new colleagues.

stimuli.title: Voicemail from the travel agency
stimuli.content: Hi, this is Mark from Blue Sky Travel. I'm calling about your trip to London. Unfortunately, your flight on Tuesday has been cancelled. We've moved you to a new flight on Thursday at nine thirty in the morning. Please arrive at the airport two hours before departure. If you have any questions, call us back at this number. Thanks, and have a great day!

questions.prompt: She ___ to school every day.
questions.explanation: Con he/she/it en presente simple el verbo lleva -s o -es: she goes.

questions.prompt: Yesterday we ___ a great movie at the cinema.
questions.explanation: 'Yesterday' indica un momento terminado en el pasado, así que se usa el pasado simple: watched.

questions.prompt: If I ___ more free time, I would learn to play the guitar.
questions.explanation: El segundo condicional (situaciones hipotéticas) usa if + pasado simple: If I had…, I would…

questions.prompt: By the time you arrive at the party, we ___ all the pizza.
questions.explanation: 'By the time…' marca una acción que ya estará terminada en el futuro: futuro perfecto (will have eaten).

questions.prompt: I have lived in Bogotá ___ 2019.
questions.explanation: 'Since' se usa con un punto de inicio (2019); 'for' se usa con una duración (for five years).

questions.prompt: Please ___ ___ the lights when you leave the room. (2 words)
questions.explanation: 'Turn off' o 'switch off' significan apagar un aparato o una luz.

questions.prompt: Why did Laura start studying English every morning?

options.text: Because she wanted to move to Toronto.
Because her new job required reading reports in English.
Because her manager asked her to train new colleagues.
Because she wanted a better salary as a nurse in Medellín.

questions.explanation: El texto dice que el trabajo era remoto y que 'every report was written in English'. Entrenar colegas fue una consecuencia, no la causa.

questions.prompt: When is the new flight?
questions.explanation: Mark dice 'a new flight on Thursday at nine thirty in the morning'. Las 7:30 es la hora de llegar al aeropuerto, no la del vuelo.

questions.prompt: Choose the opposite of "expensive".
questions.explanation: 'Cheap' (barato) es el opuesto de 'expensive' (caro). 'Costly' es un sinónimo.

questions.prompt: He was reluctant to share his opinion in the meeting. "Reluctant" means…
questions.explanation: 'Reluctant' describe a alguien que no quiere hacer algo: unwilling. 'Eager' es lo contrario.

questions.prompt: I usually take the bus to work, but today I walked because the weather was nice.

answer_key.target: I usually take the bus to work, but today I walked because the weather was nice.

questions.explanation: Se mide cuántas palabras del texto se entendieron, la claridad y el ritmo. Une las palabras sin pausas largas: 'take the bus' suena como una sola unidad.

questions.prompt: If I had more free time, I would join a cooking class and learn to make fresh pasta.

answer_key.target: If I had more free time, I would join a cooking class and learn to make fresh pasta.

questions.explanation: Segundo condicional (If I had…, I would…). Pronuncia la 'd' final de 'had' y 'would'; el acento cae en 'free time' y 'fresh pasta'.

questions.prompt: Tell me about your last weekend. What did you do, and who were you with? Speak for about 30 seconds.
questions.explanation: Se califica con una rúbrica MCER (cumplimiento de la tarea, gramática y vocabulario) más claridad y fluidez. Usa el pasado simple: 'I went', 'we watched', 'it was'.

questions.prompt: My brother ___ coffee every morning.
questions.explanation: Con he/she/it en presente simple el verbo lleva -s: my brother drinks.

questions.prompt: ___ your parents live in Cali?
questions.explanation: Las preguntas en presente simple con I/you/we/they usan 'do': Do your parents live…?

questions.prompt: Last summer my family ___ to Cartagena for a week.
questions.explanation: 'Last summer' es un momento terminado: pasado simple. 'Go' es irregular: went.

questions.prompt: She ___ her keys yesterday, so she couldn't open the door.
questions.explanation: Con 'yesterday' no se usa present perfect: se usa el pasado simple, lost.

questions.prompt: If she ___ the answer, she would tell us.
questions.explanation: Situación hipotética: if + pasado simple (knew), would + verbo (would tell).

questions.prompt: What would you do if you ___ a million dollars?
questions.explanation: El segundo condicional no lleva 'would' después de 'if': if you won…, what would you do?

questions.prompt: By next June, I ___ at this company for ten years.
questions.explanation: 'By next June' mira una acción completada en un punto del futuro: futuro perfecto, will have worked.

questions.prompt: Hurry up! By the time we get to the station, the train ___.
questions.explanation: La salida del tren ocurrirá antes de que lleguemos: futuro perfecto, will have left.

questions.prompt: We have known each other ___ ten years.
questions.explanation: 'For' va con una duración (ten years); 'since' con un punto de inicio (since 2015).

questions.prompt: She has worked at the hospital ___ last March.
questions.explanation: 'Last March' es un punto de inicio, así que se usa 'since'.

questions.prompt: I'm ___ ___ my phone. I can't find it anywhere! (2 words)
questions.explanation: 'Look for' significa buscar algo que no encuentras. 'Look at' es mirar.

questions.prompt: Can you ___ ___ this form and give it back to me? (2 words)
questions.explanation: 'Fill in' o 'fill out' significan completar un formulario.

questions.prompt: How long does Laura need to read a report now?
questions.explanation: El texto dice 'she can read a report in twenty minutes'. Treinta minutos es lo que estudia cada mañana.

questions.prompt: What did Laura do to learn new medical words?

options.text: She took classes at the hospital.
She kept a notebook with them.

questions.explanation: El texto dice 'she kept a notebook with new medical words'. Nunca se mudó: el trabajo era remoto.

questions.prompt: What happened to the original flight?
questions.explanation: Mark dice 'your flight on Tuesday has been cancelled'. No habla de retraso ni de otro aeropuerto.

questions.prompt: How early should the passenger arrive at the airport?
questions.explanation: Mark dice 'arrive at the airport two hours before departure'. Las 9:30 es la hora del vuelo.

questions.prompt: Choose the opposite of "noisy".
questions.explanation: 'Quiet' (tranquilo, silencioso) es el opuesto de 'noisy' (ruidoso). 'Loud' es un sinónimo.

questions.prompt: Choose the opposite of "arrive".
questions.explanation: 'Leave' (irse, salir) es el opuesto de 'arrive' (llegar). 'Reach' significa llegar a un lugar.

questions.prompt: The results were so ambiguous that nobody knew what to do. "Ambiguous" means…
questions.explanation: 'Ambiguous' describe algo que se puede entender de varias formas: unclear. 'Exact' es lo contrario.

questions.prompt: She gave a thorough explanation of the problem. "Thorough" means…
questions.explanation: 'Thorough' significa minucioso, que no deja nada por fuera: complete and detailed.

questions.prompt: My sister works in a small bakery, and she gets up very early every morning.

answer_key.target: My sister works in a small bakery, and she gets up very early every morning.

questions.explanation: Cuida la -s final de 'works' y 'gets'. 'Every morning' se dice de corrido, sin pausa.

questions.prompt: We visited my grandparents last Sunday and had lunch together in the garden.

answer_key.target: We visited my grandparents last Sunday and had lunch together in the garden.

questions.explanation: En 'visited' la -ed suena /ɪd/ porque el verbo termina en t. Une 'had lunch' como una sola unidad.

questions.prompt: I have been studying English for two years, and I can finally watch movies without subtitles.

answer_key.target: I have been studying English for two years, and I can finally watch movies without subtitles.

questions.explanation: Present perfect continuous: 'I have been studying'. El acento cae en 'finally' y 'without subtitles'.

questions.prompt: Although the hotel was expensive, we decided to stay there because it was close to the beach.

answer_key.target: Although the hotel was expensive, we decided to stay there because it was close to the beach.

questions.explanation: Haz una pausa breve después de 'expensive' (la coma) y no antes. 'Decided' termina en /ɪd/.

questions.prompt: Describe your favorite place in your city. Where is it, and why do you like it? Speak for about 30 seconds.
questions.explanation: Se califica con una rúbrica MCER (tarea, gramática y vocabulario) más claridad y fluidez. Usa descripciones: 'It's near…', 'There is/are…', 'I like it because…'.

questions.prompt: Tell me about a skill you would like to learn. Why is it important to you? Speak for about 30 seconds.
questions.explanation: Se califica con una rúbrica MCER (tarea, gramática y vocabulario) más claridad y fluidez. Usa 'I would like to…', 'because…' y un ejemplo concreto.
